plans.title: 30-Day Comprehensive Foundation to Ranker Roadmap
plans.target: Aspirants targeting 18+ out of 20 marks in RRB Office Assistant / PO Mains

days.action: Read Fundamentals module, inspect CPU Simulator.
Run Fetch-Decode-Execute pipeline simulator.
Study Memory Hierarchy and solve 25 memory MCQs.

days.topic: Secondary Storage & File Systems (FAT32 vs NTFS)
days.action: Compare storage drives and write flashcards.
Use Number System Converter tool (Dec, Bin, Oct, Hex).
Review I/O devices and connectors.
Take 30 questions quiz on Week 1 topics.
Read OS module and Spooling vs Buffering notes.

days.topic: Booting Process (POST, BIOS vs UEFI, MBR vs GPT)
days.action: Memorize 7 boot steps and cold vs warm boot.

days.topic: MS Word: Ribbon Tabs, Mail Merge, Formatting
days.action: Learn Word tab actions and margin definitions.

days.topic: MS Excel: Grid Architecture & Core Functions
days.action: Practice with Mini Excel Simulator (=SUM, =IF).

days.topic: MS Excel: Cell References ($A$1) & Error Codes
days.action: Memorize 8 Excel error types (#DIV/0!, #REF!).
Drill top 50 shortcuts in Keyboard Shortcut Lab.
Take 35 questions quiz on Office & OS.
Build topologies in Network Topology Builder.
Understand collision vs broadcast domains.
Use OSI Layer Inspector interactive simulator.
Memorize master port directory.

days.topic: IP Addressing: IPv4 Classes & Subnetting Basics vs IPv6
days.action: Review private IP ranges and loopback.
Read cybersecurity taxonomy and mitigation.
Run Phishing Attack Detector simulator.

weeks.title: Database, Digital Banking & Full Exam Simulation

days.action: Learn Candidate/Primary/Foreign Keys and ACID.

days.topic: SQL Sub-Languages (DDL, DML, DQL, DCL, TCL)
days.action: Review DROP vs TRUNCATE vs DELETE.
Inspect Stack/Queue animations in DS Visualizer.

days.topic: Digital Banking: RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, UPI, AePS, CTS
days.action: Memorize timing, limits, and settlement matrix.

days.topic: Card Tech, RBI Guidelines, IT Act 2000 & CERT-In
days.action: Study Section 66, CISO, and SOC rules.
Review Leitner 5-box spaced repetition deck.

days.topic: Full Length Mock Test 1 (RRB Mains 40 Qs)
days.action: Simulate real exam under 20 minutes timer.

days.topic: Mistakes Notebook Analysis & Full Length Mock Test 2
days.action: Review weak concepts and take Mock 2.
Review 50 Top Exam Traps & full forms.
